# C11 design: review workspace

This chunk covers the screens for REVIEW03 to REVIEW09 (checking, correcting, reassigning, adding, relinking and publishing), REVIEW10 (thresholds), REVIEW11 (stream-only, watermarked playback), PROF08 (favourite a clip) and NFR24 and NFR27 on every surface. It builds on D02 (`Workspace`, `ThemeScope`, states), C07 (`HlsPlayer` in host mode), C09 (clips, `ClipFavourite`) and C10 (the claimed-match page, `ReviewError` copy and the impersonation rule).

Surfaces:

1. Review workspace: the Review section of `/review/claims/[claimId]`
2. Edit event dialog (includes reassigning the player)
3. Track-link editor (the Tracks tab of the workspace side pane, plus its link dialog)
4. Add-missed-event panel
5. Mark as reviewed dialog
6. Threshold settings: `/settings/review`

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **Earlier rules still apply (D01, D02, C01 to C10).** Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Use spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12. Text uses the type classes only. Lucide icons go through `iconProps`, are `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word, or inside a control that has an `aria-label`. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule.
- **Who.** Surfaces 1 to 5 are for the scout who holds the claim, often on a phone at the sideline and otherwise on a laptop. Both are first-class (NFR24). Surface 6 is for club owners and admins (who edit) and coaches (who read), on a laptop.
- **Theme.** Surfaces 1 to 5 are **forced dark**: `Workspace theme="dark"` (a `ThemeScope`), and the dialogs render inside that scope so they are dark too. The hero, the claim facts and the Release section of the claimed-match page stay outside the scope and follow the system setting. Surface 6 follows the system setting.
- **Copy.** Use sentence case, British and South African spelling, no contractions, no exclamation marks and no emoji. Copy marked *draft* waits for legal review (Q-058). It is still final for the build.
- **Event type words** (`eventTypeLabel(type, onTarget)` in `src/lib/labels.ts`): **Goal**, **Shot on target** (`onTarget` true), **Shot off target** (false), **Shot** (null), **Touch**.
- **Event time.** Use `videoMsToMatchClock(timestampMs, markers, halfLengthMinutes).label` in `data` (**31:24**, **45+1:30**). When it returns null or an empty label (no kickoff marker, or outside play), show the video time `formatVideoTime(ms, 0)` and say so once (the side-pane caption below). Never mix the two silently.
- **Who-labels (Q-021).** A `scout_visible` player: **#7 Thabo Nkosi**. Any other lineup player: **Home #7** or **Away #7**. A lineup entry with no shirt number: **Home player, no number**. A track with no player: **Unlinked track 22**. An event with no track and no player: **Home team** or **Away team**. These labels come from `loadWorkspace()` on the server. The client never gets a name it may not show, and never sees a consent state (ConsentBadge rule: scouts never see it).
- **Side.** Use `TeamMarker` everywhere a side shows. An event or track whose side is `unknown`, or null, has no marker. It shows its who-label followed by **· side not set** in `ink-muted`, with the screen-reader prefix **Side not set:**. Colour never carries the side alone (NFR27).
- **No downloads.** Nothing in C11 links to a file. No `download` attribute, no "open in new tab", no right-click menu on the video (step 17 of the plan), and nothing goes to `localStorage`.
- **Optimistic writes.** Confirm, reject and favourite update the UI first. If the server refuses, the change is undone and the error shows in the workspace message region (below). On `claim_ended`, every action redirects to `/review/claims/{claimId}`, so the page shows the ended state with its reason (the C10 Release pattern).
- **Motion.** A saved row gets a brief `pitch-soft` flash: the background fades from `pitch-soft` to its resting fill over 200ms ease-out, with none under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Hovers take 150ms. Nothing counts up and nothing spins.
- **"Log in as" sessions (Q-064).** The workspace is read-only. J and K, selecting rows, the video, the tabs and the auto-accepted checkbox all work. No decision, link, add, swap, favourite or submit control is rendered: the rows show their chip or meter with no action buttons, and the current-event panel shows the banner below instead of its action row. The server refuses every write anyway. Banner: `Banner tone="warn"` **You are logged in as this scout. Only the scout can make review decisions.** Export it as `IMPERSONATION_REVIEW_REFUSED` from `src/server/review/errors.ts`.

### Error copy: additions to `REVIEW_ERROR_COPY` (final)

| Code | Copy | Where it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `not_attributable` | **This player's events cannot be recorded. Choose another player, or leave the event with the team.** | Field error on the player picker (edit dialog, add panel) |
| `not_attributable` (track link) | No error. The track is discarded and the discard notice in Surface 3 shows. | Tracks tab notice |
| `not_attributable` (added event) | Notice after saving: **Event added to the home team. This player's events cannot be recorded.** (away: **away team**) | Workspace message region, `tone="warn"` |
| `not_in_lineup` | **That player is not in this match's lineup. Choose a player from the list.** | Field error on the player picker |
| `raw_footage_gone` | **Raw footage for this match has been deleted, so you cannot add missed events.** | Add panel form error |
| `events_pending` | **Check the {n} events left before you mark the match as reviewed.** (1: **Check the 1 event left before you mark the match as reviewed.**) | Submit dialog form error |
| `favourite_cap` | **The club that uploaded this match cannot keep any more favourite clips.** | Workspace message region, `tone="warn"` |
| `sides_confirmed` | **Home and away are already confirmed for this match, so they cannot be swapped.** | Swap dialog form error |
| `claim_ended` | Redirects to the ended claim (C10 Surface 3). | n/a |
| any other error | **We could not save that. Try again.** (submit: **We could not mark this match as reviewed. Try again.**) | Where the action was |

A timestamp outside the video gets a field error, not a code: **Enter a time between 0:00 and {formatVideoTime(durationMs, 0)}.**

### Component changes

- **`Workspace`** (`components/templates/Workspace.tsx`): add `headingLevel?: 2 | 3` (default 2). C11 passes 3, because the workspace sits inside the page's **Review** section, whose `h2` it follows. Add `notice?: ReactNode`, rendered above the toolbar inside the theme scope.
- **`ReviewEventRow`** (`components/ui/ReviewEventRow.tsx`):
  - Extend `EventWho` with `{ kind: "label"; text: string }`.
  - Allow `side: Side | null`, rendered with the no-marker rule above.
  - Make `confidence: number | null` (manual events). When it is null, no meter shows.
  - Add `onSelect?: () => void`. When it is given, `.wl-event__time` and `.wl-event__what` sit inside one `button.wl-event__select` with the accessible name **{time}, {type}, {who}**. Clicking it selects the row.
  - Add `actions?: boolean` (default true). False hides the icon buttons (impersonation, or on phones, where the actions live in the current-event panel).
  - Add `busy?: boolean` (sets `aria-busy="true"` while a write is in flight) and `saved?: boolean` (sets `data-saved` for the flash).
  - Do **not** add the favourite toggle to the row: a 4-column pane has no room. Favourites live in the current-event panel.
  - Update `docs/design-system/components/ReviewEventRow/README.md`, its preview and the gallery fixtures (label who, side not set, manual with no meter, busy row).
- **`HlsPlayer`**: the `overlay` prop and the no-download attributes (plan step 17). The overlay sits in the screen area, above `.wl-videoplayer__bar`, so it never covers a control.
- **`SettingsNav`**: `current` gains `"review"`, and it takes `tabs: ("organisation" | "members" | "review")[]`, so a coach gets only **Review**.

### CSS: append a commented C11 block to `web/src/styles/components.css`

| Class | Rule |
|---|---|
| `.wl-event__select` | A reset button that spans the time and what cells: `grid-column: 1 / 3; display: grid; grid-template-columns: subgrid; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--radius-sm)`. Do not use `display: contents`, which drops the focus ring. Under 768px it spans the first line (`grid-column: 1 / -1`). |
| `.wl-event[data-saved]` | `animation: wl-saved 200ms ease-out`, from `background: var(--pitch-soft)`. None under reduced motion. |
| `.wl-event` (C11) | `scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--space-12) + var(--space-4))`, so `scrollIntoView` clears the sticky toolbar. |
| `.wl-review__video` | From 1280px: `position: sticky; top: calc(var(--space-12) + var(--space-4)); align-self: start`. Under 768px in portrait: `position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 4; background: var(--surface)` with `padding-bottom: var(--space-2)`. |
| `.wl-review__current` | The current-event panel: `.wl-card` padding `space-3`, `margin-top: var(--space-3)`, grid with `gap: var(--space-2)`. |
| `.wl-review__actions` | `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-2)`. Under 768px: a 3-column grid of 48px buttons (Confirm, Edit, Reject), then a 2-column row (Previous, Next). |
| `.wl-watermark` | `position: absolute; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-sunken) 40%, transparent)`, type `label`. Six position modifiers `--tl`, `--tr`, `--ml`, `--mr`, `--bl`, `--br`, each inset `space-4` from the screen edges (the bottom ones sit above the control bar). `transition: opacity 200ms ease-out`, and none under reduced motion. |
| `.wl-tabs [role="tab"]` | The same rules as `.wl-tabs a`, with `[aria-selected="true"]` in place of `[aria-current="page"]`. Resets the button background and border. |
| `.wl-nudge` | The four nudge buttons in the add panel: `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-2)`. |

## Surface 1: review workspace, `/review/claims/[claimId]`

**Who, where, job.** The claiming scout, on a laptop (keyboard first) or a phone (touch, at the sideline). One job: go through every below-threshold event with its clip, decide each one, fix what is wrong, and publish.

**Access and data.** The page keeps `requireReviewerPage()` and `ownClaim()` (C10). With an active claim it calls `claimScope(ctx, claimId)`, `loadWorkspace(scope)` and `claimFacts(scope)`. Signed URLs come from the claim-checked routes only. The page keeps metadata title **Claimed match**.

### Page order (DOM order, changes to C10 Surface 3)

1. Hero (unchanged).
2. Notice (unchanged: the `?done` live region, the `ExpiryBanner` or the clips-only banner).
3. Section **Review** (`id="review"`, `h2` visible): the `Workspace`.
4. Section **Your claim** (unchanged facts card).
5. Section **Release** (unchanged).

The workspace moves above **Your claim**, so the work is the first thing after the notices.

### Workspace notice (inside the dark scope, above the toolbar)

`div[aria-live="polite"]` workspace message region, always rendered (`empty:hidden`). It holds one `Banner` at a time, and the newest message replaces the last. It is cleared by the next successful action. Messages:

- Write errors (the error table above).
- **Home and away swapped. {n} track links were removed.** (`ok`; n 0: **Home and away swapped.**)
- The track discard notice (Surface 3).
- The added-event notice (Surface 4).

Then, when `claimFacts().sidesUnconfirmed` and the claim is live: `Banner tone="warn"` **We could not tell which team is home from the footage. Check a few events, and swap home and away if they are the wrong way round.**

### Toolbar (`wl-workspace__toolbar`, sticky at 768px and up, static under 768px)

In order:

| Element | Component, tokens | Copy |
|---|---|---|
| Progress | `p.body-strong`, `aria-live="polite"`, with the number in `data` | **8 of 12 checked**. When all are checked: **All 12 checked**. With no below-threshold events: **Nothing to check** |
| Auto-accepted | `label.wl-choice` with a checkbox | **Show auto-accepted events ({n})**. Hidden when n is 0 |
| Swap | `Button variant="ghost" size="sm"`, icon `ArrowLeftRight`, opens a `ConfirmDialog` | **Swap home and away**. Only when the sides are unconfirmed and the claim is live |
| Spacer | `flex: 1` | |
| Mark as reviewed | Surface 5 trigger | |

"Checked" counts below-threshold events whose status is no longer `pending_review`. Manual events do not count towards it.

**Swap dialog** (`ConfirmDialog`, the C10 pattern):

| Part | Content |
|---|---|
| title | **Swap home and away?** |
| body | **Every event and track in this match changes side.** Plus, when n > 0: **{n} track links to players of the other team are removed, so you will need to link those tracks again.** |
| hidden | `claimId` |
| submit | `primary` **Swap sides**, pending **Swapping…** |
| cancel | **Cancel** (initial focus) |

### Primary pane: **Match video** (`h3`, visually hidden)

`div.wl-review__video` contains, in order:

1. **Player.** `HlsPlayer`, `keyboard="host"`, title **Match video: {fixtureText}**, with `overlay={<ReviewWatermark />}`.
   - HLS while it exists. Selecting an event seeks to `clipStartMs` (or the timestamp minus 5 s, clamped at 0). It keeps playing if the video was playing, and otherwise stays paused there.
   - Clips only: `source={ kind: "file" }` from `/api/review/claims/{claimId}/clips/{clipId}`, swapped on every selection. When the current event has no clip (a manual event, or a clip that has gone), the player is replaced by `div.wl-video` on `surface-sunken`, `radius-md`, 16:9, with `p.body.text-ink-muted` **There is no clip for this event, and the raw footage has been deleted.**
2. **Video actions** (`div.wl-row.mt-3`):
   - `Button ghost sm`, icon `RotateCcw`: **Replay clip**. It seeks to the clip start and plays.
   - `Button ghost sm`, icon `Plus`: **Add missed event**. It opens Surface 4. In a clips-only match it is `aria-disabled="true"` with `aria-describedby` pointing at a `caption.text-ink-muted` **Raw footage deleted. You cannot add missed events.** Activating it does nothing.
   - `details` **Keyboard shortcuts** (the C07 pattern), listing **J** Next event, **K** Previous event, **Y** Confirm, **N** Reject, **E** Edit, **Space** Play or pause, **← →** Move 5 s.
3. **Current-event panel** (`section.wl-review__current`, `aria-labelledby` its `h4.eyebrow` **Current event**):
   - Line 1: time in `data`, type in `body-strong`, and the who-label with `TeamMarker` (not truncated here).
   - Line 2: `ConfidenceMeter` with the words **below threshold** when it is low (README detail-view rule). Then the state as an `EventStatusChip`, and for an edited event `caption` **corrected**. Manual events show **Added by you** in `caption` and no meter.
   - Line 3, the action row `div.wl-review__actions`:
     - `Button secondary`, icon `ChevronUp`: **Previous <Kbd>K</Kbd>**
     - `Button secondary`, icon `ChevronDown`: **Next <Kbd>J</Kbd>**
     - `Button secondary`, icon `Check`: **Confirm <Kbd>Y</Kbd>**
     - `Button secondary`, icon `Pencil`: **Edit <Kbd>E</Kbd>**
     - `Button danger`, icon `X`: **Reject <Kbd>N</Kbd>**
     - `Button ghost sm`, icon `Star` (`fill="currentColor"` when pressed), `aria-pressed`: **Favourite clip**. It shows only when the event has a clip. When pressed, its fill is `pitch-soft` with text `pitch`.
   - There is no primary here: the one primary is **Mark as reviewed**.
   - The panel always shows Confirm, Edit and Reject, also for a handled event, because a decision can be changed. The button matching the current state is `aria-disabled` (for example **Confirm** on a confirmed event).

On a phone, the panel holds the only action buttons (ReviewEventRow README, "Phone").

### Side pane: **Events** and **Tracks** (`h3`, visually hidden: **Review lists**)

`div.wl-tabs[role="tablist"][aria-label="Review lists"]` with two `button[role="tab"]` controls: **Events ({n})** and **Tracks ({n})**. The tab panels are `div[role="tabpanel"]`. Arrow keys move between the tabs (the ARIA tabs pattern, manual activation). The Tracks tab is Surface 3.

**Events panel:**

- `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: **Times are match times.** Or, without usable markers: **The club has not set kickoff, so times are video times.**
- `ul[aria-label="Events"]`, with the classes `overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-line`, of `ReviewEventRow` in timestamp order:
  - Default: the below-threshold set (`pending_review`, plus confirmed, rejected and manual events).
  - With the checkbox ticked: auto-accepted events too, in the same order, with the **Auto-accepted** chip.
- A row: time, type, the who-label (TeamMarker, `truncate`), `note` **corrected** for an edited or reassigned event, the meter on pending rows, and the chip on handled rows.
  - At 768px and up, `actions` is true. Under 768px it is false, so the panel buttons do the work.
  - `current` marks the selected row. `onSelect` selects it.

**Selection:**

- On load, the current event is the first `pending_review` event, else the first row.
- J (or **Next**) moves to the next row in list order and K (or **Previous**) to the previous one. They stop at the ends without wrapping, and announce **Last event.** or **First event.**
- The current row scrolls into view with `block: "nearest"`. Focus does not move.

**Decisions and auto-advance:**

- Y, N or a button: the row updates at once and flashes, and the progress line updates.
- The current event then moves to the next `pending_review` event after this one. If there is none after it, it moves to the first one from the top. If none is left, it stays where it is.

### Watermark (`ReviewWatermark.tsx`)

- `div.wl-watermark` with `aria-hidden="true"`. Text: **{scout display name} · Claim {last 6 characters of claimId, uppercase}**, for example **Lebo Mokoena · Claim 4F7K2Q**.
- In a "Log in as" session, the text is **{scout name} · Claim 4F7K2Q · Wideline staff**.
- The position moves to the next of the six positions every 20 s, in a fixed order that starts from a position based on the claim id. The text fades to 0 opacity and back, which is an instant jump under reduced motion.
- It stays on screen in full screen, because it renders inside the player root.
- It also shows over the clips-only `file` source.

### Keyboard (workspace)

One `keydown` listener on `document` while the workspace is mounted and the claim is live. A key is ignored when:

- a modifier key is held (Ctrl, Meta or Alt; Shift is allowed only for the capital letters);
- the target is an `input`, `select`, `textarea` or `[contenteditable]`;
- the target is inside a `[data-review-keys="off"]` region (the add panel, the player's quality and captions menus);
- any `dialog[open]` exists.

| Key | Action | `preventDefault` |
|---|---|---|
| J / j | Next event | yes |
| K / k | Previous event | yes |
| Y / y | Confirm current (not in "Log in as") | yes |
| N / n | Reject current (not in "Log in as") | yes |
| E / e | Open the edit dialog (not in "Log in as") | yes |
| Space | Play or pause, unless the target is a `button`, `a`, `summary` or `[role="tab"]` (those keep their native Space) | yes when used |
| ← / → | Seek by 5 s, unless the target is the seek slider or a `[role="tab"]` | yes when used |

Put the key map in a pure module (`review-keys.ts`) with `keyAction(event, context)`, so the unit test covers it.

**Tab order:**

1. The toolbar: checkbox, **Swap home and away**, **Mark as reviewed**.
2. The player controls.
3. **Replay clip**, **Add missed event**, **Keyboard shortcuts**.
4. The current-event panel buttons.
5. The tabs.
6. In each row, the select button, then Confirm, Edit and Reject.

**Screen readers:**

- A polite live region (`p.sr-only[aria-live="polite"]`) inside the side pane announces each selection: **Event 3 of 12. 31:24, Shot on target, Home side, #7 Thabo Nkosi, 0.68 confidence, pending review.**
- After a decision, it announces **Confirmed.** or **Rejected.**, then the next event in the same form.
- When none are left: **All events checked. You can mark the match as reviewed.**
- The icon buttons keep their `aria-label`s, which name their shortcuts (**Confirm (Y)**).
- `aria-keyshortcuts` goes on the panel buttons: `J`, `K`, `Y`, `N`, `E`.

### Layout

| Width | Layout |
|---|---|
| **375** | The dark scope is padded `space-4`. The toolbar is static and wraps: the progress line, then the checkbox, then the swap button, then **Mark as reviewed** full width at 48px. The video pane is sticky at the top in portrait, with the player, the video actions and the current-event panel (3 × 48px decision buttons, then Previous and Next side by side). The tabs and the event list scroll under it. Rows stack on two lines with no action buttons. The keyboard shortcuts `details` is hidden under 768px. |
| **768** | The scope is padded `space-6`. The toolbar is sticky on one line where it fits. The panes are stacked: the video full width (not sticky), the panel buttons at their natural width in one wrapping row, then the tabs and the list. Rows show their action buttons on one line. |
| **1280** | The panes are side by side, 8 and 4 columns. The video pane is sticky under the toolbar. The side pane scrolls with the page, and its rows sit on two lines (the existing `.wl-workspace__side` rule). |

### States

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| **Loading** | `loading.tsx`: `DetailSkeleton` hero lines, then `WorkspaceSkeleton`. Write in flight: the row has `aria-busy` and the buttons stay enabled, with a repeated key queued in order. |
| **Empty: nothing below threshold** | The events panel shows a compact `EmptyState` (no art): title **No events to check**, body **Every event in this match was above the threshold. You can look through the auto-accepted events, then mark the match as reviewed.** The current-event panel is hidden until an event is selected. |
| **Empty: no events at all** | Title **No events found**, body **The model found no goals, shots or touches in this match. Add any it missed, then mark the match as reviewed.** |
| **Small sample** | 1 event: **0 of 1 checked**, with the singular copy everywhere (**1 event left to check**). |
| **Long content** | Long who-labels truncate in rows (`TeamMarker truncate`), with the full label in the panel. The fixture wraps in the hero. More than 200 rows are rendered in full (no virtualisation in v0), with `content-visibility: auto` on the rows. |
| **Partial data** | No markers: the video-time caption. No tracks: the Tracks tab says so (Surface 3). No lineup for a side: the picker note (Surface 2). An unknown side: the no-marker rule. |
| **Clips only** | The clips-only banner (page notice). The player plays clips. **Add missed event** is disabled with its reason. |
| **Video error** | `HlsPlayer`'s own error panel. The list and decisions keep working. |
| **Write refused** | The change is undone, the row returns to its last state, and the error banner shows in the message region. |
| **Claim ended mid-session** | Any write redirects to the ended claim. The video routes answer 404, so the player shows its **gone** message. |
| **Forbidden** | Not a scout: `/forbidden`. Another scout's claim: 404 (C10). |
| **"Log in as"** | Read-only, as in the rules above. |

## Surface 2: edit event dialog (`EditEventDialog.tsx`)

**Who, where, job.** The scout, from E, the **Edit** button or a row's pencil. One job: correct the type, the side or the player of one event, which also confirms it.

A native `dialog.wl-dialog` inside the dark scope, with `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`. Focus starts on the first field. Esc closes it and returns focus to the control that opened it.

| Part | Component | Copy |
|---|---|---|
| Title | `h2.heading-2` | **Edit event** |
| Body | `p.body.text-ink-muted` | **{time} · {type} · {who}**, then **Saving confirms the event.** |
| Type | `fieldset.wl-field`, legend `label`, `wl-choice` radios | **Event type**: **Goal**, **Shot**, **Touch** |
| On target | `wl-choice` checkbox, shown only for Shot | **On target** |
| Side | radios with a `TeamMarker` in each label | **Side**: **Home · {team name}**, **Away · {team name}** |
| Player | `select.wl-input` inside `Field` | Label **Player**. The first option is **No player (team only)**, then the chosen side's lineup entries, labelled per Q-021 and ordered by shirt number. Changing the side reloads the options and resets the player to **No player (team only)**. When the side has no lineup, the select is replaced by `p.body.text-ink-muted` **The club has not entered a lineup for this side.** |
| Hint | `wl-field__hint caption` | **Choosing a player moves this event to them. To move every event of a track, use the Tracks tab.** |
| Actions | `wl-dialog__actions` | **Cancel** (secondary), **Save and confirm** (primary, pending **Saving…**) |

**Behaviour:**

- One action. A changed player calls `reassignEventAction`, and the other fields call `editEventAction`, run in that order. If either refuses, the dialog stays open with the error and nothing is shown as saved.
- On success the dialog closes, the row flashes with **corrected** and the current event auto-advances.
- `not_attributable` and `not_in_lineup` show as field errors on **Player**. Focus moves to it.

**States:** the pending button is disabled; a field error uses `aria-invalid` and `wl-field__error`; any other error shows in the `FormErrorBanner`.

**Layout:** at 375 the fields are full width and the actions stack (the existing `wl-dialog` phone rule). At 768 and 1280 the dialog is `wl-dialog` width.

## Surface 3: track-link editor (Tracks tab and `TrackLinkEditor.tsx`)

**Who, where, job.** The scout, usually after watching a few events by the same unlinked player. One job: link a track to the right lineup player, so every event on it moves at once.

**Tracks panel:**

- `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **A track is one player the model followed. Linking it moves all its events to that player.**
- `ul[aria-label="Tracks"]` with `border border-line rounded-md`. Each `li` is a 2-line row on `surface-raised` with `line` dividers and `space-3` padding:
  - Line 1: `body-strong` **Track 22**, then the `TeamMarker` side, then the link in `body`: the who-label, or **Not linked** in `ink-muted`.
  - Line 2: `caption.text-ink-muted` **6 events** (1: **1 event**), then the buttons:
    - `Button ghost sm`, icon `Play`: **Watch**. It seeks the video to the track's first event. The accessible name is **Watch track 22**.
    - `Button secondary sm`, icon `Link`: **Link player** when unlinked, **Change link** when linked. The accessible names are **Link player to track 22** and **Change link for track 22**.
- Order: unlinked tracks with events first, then linked tracks, each by event count (most first), then by index.
- Tracks with no events sit behind a `details` labelled **Tracks with no events ({n})**.

**Link dialog** (`ConfirmDialog` with children):

| Part | Content |
|---|---|
| title | **Link track 22** |
| body | **Choose the player this track follows.** |
| field | `select.wl-input`, label **Player**: **No player (unlink)**, then the lineup entries of the track's side (Q-021 labels). For an unknown side, `optgroup`s **Home · {team}** and **Away · {team}**. |
| effect line | `p.body[aria-live="polite"]`, updated as the choice changes. A player: **This moves {n} events to {label}.** No player: **This unlinks the track. Its {n} events go back to the team.** n 0: **This track has no events yet.** Unchanged: **No change.** |
| submit | `primary` **Link track**, or **Unlink track** when no player is chosen. Pending **Saving…**. Disabled when there is no change. |
| cancel | **Cancel** |

**After saving:**

- The track row and every moved event row update and flash.
- A moved event's who-label changes. An event that was reassigned on its own (`playerSource` reviewer) keeps its player, and its count is not part of n.

**Discard (Q-065):** a refused link removes the track row. The message region shows `Banner tone="warn"` **Track 22 was removed. This player's events cannot be recorded, so its {n} events stay with the team.** The events now read **Home team** or **Away team**.

**States:**

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| **No tracks** | Compact `EmptyState`: **No tracks found**, **The model did not follow any players in this match. You can still check events and give them to a player one at a time.** |
| **No lineup** | Each row's link button is `aria-disabled`, with the caption **The club has not entered a lineup for this side.** |
| **Many tracks** | The full list with the no-event tracks folded away. No pagination. |
| **Long labels** | Wrap on line 1. |
| **Error** | In the dialog's `FormErrorBanner`. |
| **"Log in as"** | Only the Watch buttons. |

**Keyboard:**

- Tab moves through Watch, then Link, row by row.
- In the dialog, focus starts on the select and Enter submits.
- The workspace keys are ignored while the dialog is open.
- After saving, focus returns to that row's link button. After a discard, it goes to the next row's link button, or to the Tracks tab if no row is left.

---

## Surface 4: add-missed-event panel (`AddMissedEventPanel.tsx`)

**Who, where, job.** The scout, when they see a goal, shot or touch the model missed. One job: mark the moment and say what happened, while the raw footage exists.

**Not a modal (design choice).** The plan's `AddMissedEventDialog` becomes an inline panel. It replaces the current-event panel under the video, so the video stays visible and the nudge buttons move it. It is a `section.wl-review__current[data-review-keys="off"]` with `aria-labelledby` its `h4.eyebrow` **Add missed event**.

| Part | Component | Copy |
|---|---|---|
| Time | `Field`, `input.wl-input.data`, `inputmode="decimal"`, prefilled with `formatVideoTime(player.currentMs, 1)` on open | Label **Video time**. Hint: **Match time {clock} · {phase}**, for example **Match time 31:24 · First half**. Without markers: **The club has not set kickoff.** The input pauses the video on open. Typing a valid time seeks the video there on blur. |
| Nudge | `div.wl-nudge` of `Button secondary sm` | **Back 1 s**, **Back 0.1 s**, **Forward 0.1 s**, **Forward 1 s**. Each moves the video and the field. |
| Use playhead | `Button ghost sm`, icon `Crosshair` | **Use current video time** |
| Type, On target, Side, Player | The same fields and copy as Surface 2. The player is optional. | |
| Actions | `div.wl-row` | **Cancel** (ghost), **Add event** (secondary, icon `Plus`, pending **Adding…**) |

**Behaviour:**

- On success the panel closes and a row with the **Manual** chip appears in timestamp order and becomes the current event. The polite region says **Event added at {time}.**
- A `not_attributable` player is handled as in the error table: the event is added at team level and the warn notice shows.
- `raw_footage_gone` shows as the form error, and the panel stays open. The footage may have expired while the page was open.
- Esc or **Cancel** closes the panel and returns focus to **Add missed event**.

**States:**

- An invalid time shows `aria-invalid` and the field error.
- A time outside the video shows the range error.
- In a clips-only match the panel cannot open (the disabled trigger on Surface 1).
- In "Log in as" there is no trigger.

**Layout:**

- 375: the panel replaces the sticky panel area, so it scrolls with the page (`position: static` while it is open, so the form fits). The nudge row is 4 equal 48px buttons, and the fields stack.
- 768 and 1280: the nudge row and the radios sit inline.

**Keyboard:**

- Focus starts on **Video time**.
- Tab order: the time, the nudge buttons, **Use current video time**, Type, On target, Side, Player, **Cancel**, **Add event**.
- The workspace keys are off inside the panel (`data-review-keys="off"`), so Y typed anywhere in it does nothing.

---

## Surface 5: Mark as reviewed (`SubmitReview.tsx`)

**Who, where, job.** The scout, when every below-threshold event is handled. One job: publish the match and end the claim, knowing that it cannot be undone.

**Trigger** (in the toolbar):

- `Button primary`, icon `Check`, labelled **Mark as reviewed**.
- While events are left, it is `aria-disabled="true"`, with `aria-describedby` pointing at `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **{n} events left to check** (1: **1 event left to check**) beside it.
- Activating it while disabled does not open the dialog. It selects the first `pending_review` event and announces **Check the {n} events left first.**

**Dialog** (`ConfirmDialog`):

| Part | Content |
|---|---|
| title | **Mark this match as reviewed?** |
| body | **The events you checked are published to player profiles, and your access to this match's footage ends. You cannot change your review after this.** |
| children | `dl.wl-facts`: **Events checked** {n} · **Corrections** {n} · **Missed events added** {n} (numbers in `data`). The figures follow `claimCounts` (Q-067): confirmations are not corrections. |
| hidden | `claimId` |
| submit | `primary` **Mark as reviewed**, pending **Publishing…** |
| cancel | **Cancel** (initial focus) |

**After:**

- Success redirects to `/review/claims/{claimId}?done=submitted`, which shows the ended claim: **You marked this match as reviewed. Thank you.** (C10 copy).
- `events_pending` shows in the dialog (another tab may have changed the count).
- `claim_ended` redirects.

**Layout:**

- At 375 the trigger is full width at 48px, with the caption under it, and the dialog actions stack.
- At 768 and 1280 the trigger is at the end of the toolbar, with the caption to its left.

---

## Surface 6: threshold settings, `/settings/review`

**Who, where, job.** Club owners and admins on a laptop, who tune how much goes to review. Coaches, who look up why an event was or was not checked. One job: set the confidence an event needs to skip review, per event type.

**Access:**

- `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)`. A scout-network or platform organisation gets `notFound()`.
- The action uses `requireRole(ORG_ADMIN_ROLES)`.
- Metadata title **Review settings**.
- Coaches have no Settings nav item (D02 nav). They reach the page by its URL, and the page shows them only the **Review** tab (Q-071).

**Structure:**

- `PageHeader`: title **Review settings**, intro **How sure the model must be before an event is accepted without a scout checking it.**
- `SettingsNav current="review"`. Owners and admins see **Organisation**, **Members** and **Review**. Coaches see **Review** only.
- `section.wl-card.mt-8.max-w-xl[aria-labelledby]`:
  - `h2.heading-2` **Auto-accept thresholds**
  - `p.body.mt-2` **Events at or above the threshold are accepted without review. Events below it go to a scout. A higher threshold sends more events to review.**
  - The form (`ThresholdsForm.tsx`, the C01 `SettingsForm` pattern: `useFormAction`, `FormBusy`, a polite `SuccessBanner`, `useFocusFirstInvalid`). There is one `Field` per type:

| Field | Label | Input | Hint |
|---|---|---|---|
| goal | **Goals** | `input.wl-input.data`, `inputmode="decimal"`, width `calc(var(--space-12) * 2)` | **Default 0.90** |
| shot | **Shots** | as above | **Default 0.75** |
| touch | **Touches** | as above | **Default 0.80** |

**Values:**

- Values are confidence scores (**0.75**) shown to 2 decimals, the same form a scout sees in the meter. Percentages are not used (Q-072). `thresholdsInputSchema` validates a decimal from 0 to 1 with up to 2 decimals, so no conversion is needed.
- Error: **Enter a number from 0.00 to 1.00.**
- Below 0.50, an inline `wl-inline-status--warn` under the field: **At {value}, most {goals|shots|touches} are accepted without a scout checking them.**
- `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Changes apply to matches processed from now on. Matches already processed keep their events as they are.** (Q-069)
- Submit: `primary` **Save thresholds**, pending **Saving…**. Success: **Thresholds saved.**

**Coach view:** the same card and text, but the form is replaced by `dl.wl-facts` (**Goals** `0.90`, with **(default)** in `ink-muted` when the value is the default). Then `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Only owners and admins can change these.**

**States:**

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| Loading | `DetailSkeleton` (`settings/review/loading.tsx`) |
| Field errors | Per field, with focus on the first invalid one |
| Server error | `FormErrorBanner`: **We could not save the thresholds. Try again.** |
| Forbidden (coach posting) | `FormErrorBanner`: **Only owners and admins can change review settings.** |
| No settings stored | Every field shows its default |
| Long organisation name | The intro wraps |

**Layout:**

- 375: the gutter is `space-4`, the card is full width, the fields stack with a 44px input height, and **Save thresholds** is full width at 48px.
- 768: `space-6`, and the card is `max-w-xl`.
- 1280: the same, inside the content column.

**Keyboard:** the tabs, then Goals, Shots, Touches, **Save thresholds**. Enter submits. Each hint and warning is linked to its input with `aria-describedby`.
